programme.title: Healthy Kitchen
programme.desc: The host prepares a wide range of healthy and delicious recipes using natural and seasonal ingredients to encourage the viewers to experiment in their kitchen.

programme.title: Ayurveda Kamasutra
programme.desc: The host invites experts to discuss Ayurvedic approaches to sexual health, covering topics like male fertility, menopause and urinary health, with practical remedies and advice for overall well-being.

programme.title: Inside The Mind
programme.desc: The host and expert discuss healthy ways to manage daily emotions, offering tips for mental well-being and raising awareness about psychiatric issues caused by our fast-paced lives.

programme.title: R D Brahman

programme.title: Ayush Mantra
programme.desc: The host engages with health professionals, gathering and sharing expert tips and strategies for achieving and maintaining optimal physical well-being.

programme.title: Raita Bandhu
programme.desc: The host provides a detailed report on various matters pertaining to agriculture in order to equip the farming community with key information.

programme.title: Sri Guru Sarvabhouma
programme.desc: The host sheds light on the life journey and contributions of Raghavendra Tirtha, a Vaishnava scholar and saint born in Tamil Nadu.

programme.title: Namami Ayush
programme.desc: A medical professional explains various common ailments and their remedies, offering tips for maintaining a healthy lifestyle.

programme.title: Sri Venkateshwara Suprabatham
programme.desc: The rendering of 'Sri Venkateswara Suprabhatam', a hymn recited every morning at the Tirumala hill shrine, as a wake-up call for Lord Venkateswara.

programme.title: Dhanvantri Mantra
programme.desc: A rendition of the sacred chant, 'dhanvantari mahamantram' dedicated to the lord of medicine, to bestow good health on the devotees.

programme.title: We Bare Bears
programme.desc: Three brother bears awkwardly attempt to find their place in civilized society, whether they're looking for food, trying to make human friends, or scheming to become famous on the internet. Grizzly, Panda and Ice Bear stack atop one another when they leave their cave and explore the hipster environs of the San Francisco Bay Area, and it's clear the siblings have a lot to learn about a technologically driven world. By their side on many adventures are best friend Chloe (the only human character in the cast), fame-obsessed panda Nom Nom, and Charlie, aka Bigfoot.

Jake Sully, a paralysed former marine, becomes mobile again through one such Avatar and falls in love with a Na'vi woman. As his bond with her grows, he is drawn into a battle for the survival of her world.

programme.title: Nancy Drew
programme.desc: Nancy Drew is a brilliant teen detective whose sense of self had come from solving mysteries in her hometown of Horseshoe Bay, Maine -- until her mother's untimely death derails Nancy's college plans. Devastated by her mother's passing, Nancy swears off crime-solving while crossing off the days until she can reapply to college. But when a socialite is murdered, Nancy finds herself a prime suspect in the crime, along with a group of other teens present at the scene: Nancy's nemesis from high school, George Fan; a rich girl with a mysterious past, Bess Marvin; Nancy's secret boyfriend, Ned "Nick" Nickerson and amiable burnout Ace. The five of them must team up to clear their own names, encountering emotional entanglements and even more mysteries along the way.

programme.title: Jane The Virgin
programme.desc: The daughter of a teen mother, Jane Villanueva grew up determined not to repeat her mom's mistakes. At 23, her life is on track; Jane is studying to be a teacher and engaged to a handsome detective who supports her decision to remain a virgin until marriage. Then a routine clinic visit flips her life upside down. Inseminated by a specimen meant for a patient in the next room, now-pregnant Jane is in a situation made only more insane when she learns that the sperm donor is her boss, Rafael. As her meticulously planned life gets more like the telenovelas she loves, she faces a lot of complicated decisions about where to go from here.

programme.desc: Kanchan, a motherless young woman, deals with an evil and torturing stepmother after Jeevan, her father, remarries after his wife's death.

programme.title: Maina Popat
programme.desc: Gorbha adopts an abandoned child, Maina, giving her a new life. As Maina grows up, her marriage to the manipulative Pathuba leads to unforeseen challenges and personal struggles.

programme.title: Lohi Bhini Chundadi
programme.desc: Two brothers, separated at birth, grow up to become rivals. However, a reunion with their mother sets the duo on a path to avenge their father's death.

programme.title: Mane Laide Ne Navarang Chundadi
programme.desc: Celebrating the heritage of Gujarati textile art, highlighting the age-old, colorful and culturally significant tradition of Navarang Chundadi.

programme.title: Gajjar Ni Pipudi
programme.desc: Popat and Pipudi's love hits a standstill when Vandechand, Maina's father, opposes their relationship. However, a surprising incident shifts his point of view, transforming their future.

programme.title: Corporate
programme.desc: Matt and Jake, two junior executives working at Hampton DeVille, a soulless multinational corporation, try to survive and navigate their workplace.

programme.title: Jane The Virgin
programme.desc: The daughter of a teen mother, Jane Villanueva grew up determined not to repeat her mom's mistakes. At 23, her life is on track; Jane is studying to be a teacher and engaged to a handsome detective who supports her decision to remain a virgin until marriage. Then a routine clinic visit flips her life upside down. Inseminated by a specimen meant for a patient in the next room, now-pregnant Jane is in a situation made only more insane when she learns that the sperm donor is her boss, Rafael. As her meticulously planned life gets more like the telenovelas she loves, she faces a lot of complicated decisions about where to go from here.

programme.title: Dexter
programme.desc: Dexter Morgan, a man with murderous impulses, leads a double life. He works as a forensic technician for the police department during the day and kills heinous criminals in his free time.

programme.title: Shark Tank
programme.desc: Budding entrepreneurs get the chance to bring their dreams to fruition in this reality show from executive producer Mark Burnett. They present their ideas to the sharks - five titans of industry who made their own dreams a reality and turned their ideas into lucrative empires.The entrepreneurs try to convince any one of the sharks to invest money in their idea or business. When more than one of the sharks decide they want a piece of the action, a bidding war can erupt, driving up the price of the investment.

programme.title: The Good Doctor
programme.desc: Shaun, a young doctor, joins a renowned hospital in San Jose, California, but his colleagues do not socialise with him. He uses his skills to treat patients and prove his abilities to his co-workers.

programme.title: Nancy Drew
programme.desc: Nancy Drew is a brilliant teen detective whose sense of self had come from solving mysteries in her hometown of Horseshoe Bay, Maine -- until her mother's untimely death derails Nancy's college plans. Devastated by her mother's passing, Nancy swears off crime-solving while crossing off the days until she can reapply to college. But when a socialite is murdered, Nancy finds herself a prime suspect in the crime, along with a group of other teens present at the scene: Nancy's nemesis from high school, George Fan; a rich girl with a mysterious past, Bess Marvin; Nancy's secret boyfriend, Ned "Nick" Nickerson and amiable burnout Ace. The five of them must team up to clear their own names, encountering emotional entanglements and even more mysteries along the way.

The guys test their mettle by competing in location-inspired challenges across several states, with only a limited set of tools at their disposal. Canterbury's vast survival experience supplements the construction skills of Littlefield ("Dude Room," "Extreme Makeover: Home Edition") and the sustainability expertise of Strawbridge, a U.K. Army veteran well known for his popular BBC series "It's Not Easy Being Green."

programme.title: Last of the Giants: Wild Fish
programme.desc: Cyril Chauquet and his team are dropped into the middle of the wildest environments on the planet with the sole mission of collecting vital specimens that could save species from extinction. After years of habitat destruction, pollution and commercial pressure, Chauquet and his team are on tight deadlines to make it through the dangerous, rugged terrain and back to civilization. The teams seek out some of the most endangered freshwater goliaths from the Great North of the Americas and the Amazon rainforest, including the armor-plated white sturgeon, the prehistoric pirarucu and the hulking piraiba.

programme.desc: Survivalist Hazen Audel fights his way through 500 miles of unexplored Amazon using only traditional survival methods; he faces extreme environments, and he must reach the Atlantic coast before he's trapped by floods during the rainy season.

programme.title: Airport Security: Madrid
programme.desc: The filmmaker gives an insight into behind the scenes of security personnel, highlighting the measures taken by them to keep check of suspicious objects and maintain security.

programme.title: Destruction Decoded
programme.desc: An in-depth look at catastrophic events, analysing the science behind natural and man-made disasters and exploring the causes and consequences through expert insights and CGI visuals.

programme.title: India's Jungle Heroes
programme.desc: Conservationists confront difficult situations in India's jungles to rescue animals in distress while trying to find a way for the locals and wildlife to coexist.

programme.title: Airport Security: Brazil
programme.desc: Federal police at São Paulo International Airport work 24-7 to stop illegal activity in Brazil; their main threat is cocaine smuggling.

programme.title: Primal Survivor: Mighty Mekong
programme.desc: Hazen Audel seeks out a hidden Mekong village in a survival challenge; he relies only on the traditional survival skills of the natives.

programme.title: Last of the Giants: Wild Fish
programme.desc: Cyril Chauquet and his team are dropped into the middle of the wildest environments on the planet with the sole mission of collecting vital specimens that could save species from extinction. After years of habitat destruction, pollution and commercial pressure, Chauquet and his team are on tight deadlines to make it through the dangerous, rugged terrain and back to civilization. The teams seek out some of the most endangered freshwater goliaths from the Great North of the Americas and the Amazon rainforest, including the armor-plated white sturgeon, the prehistoric pirarucu and the hulking piraiba.

programme.title: India's Mega Festivals
programme.desc: Chefs Gary Mehigan and Pablo Naranjo travel across India to experience the grandest cultural and religious festivals in the country.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay: Uncharted
programme.desc: Celebrity Chef Gordon Ramsay travels around the world to immerse himself into different cultures and cuisines. He then interacts with local chefs to learn and compete with them.

programme.title: Resq Squad
programme.desc: A group of ardent animal lovers set off on a noble and risky mission to rescue animals who are stuck in dangerous situations.

programme.title: India's Mega Kitchen
programme.desc: Focusing on some of India's biggest and most iconic kitchens, the process surrounding cooking and the history of the environment.

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's India
programme.desc: Luke Nguyen circumnavigates southern India, discovering the sounds, colors and cuisines of the region, meeting local cooks and chefs, who introduce him to the world of Indian cuisine.

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Asian Street Food
programme.desc: Chef Luke Nguyen takes us on a lively tour of Asian street food, exploring the food and culture of Vietnam, Thailand, Malaysia and Indonesia.

programme.title: Primal Survivor Cutdowns
programme.desc: Wilderness and survival expert Hazen Audel takes treacherous paths in this documentary series. Using his knowledge and skills, Audel sets off on a journey via lesser traveled roads, where the terrain is unstable and the elements are often harsh and unpredictable. Stopping in local communities, Audel speaks to native residents to gather as much information about the area as possible. Following in the footsteps of the Embera tribe, the survival guide goes on a jungle trek through the Darien Gap. In other episodes, he navigates the Arctic Circle with 200 reindeer in tow and crosses crocodile-infested lakes.

At John Quincy Adams Middle School in Manhattan, Riley finds being a student more difficult because her dad is a history teacher there, and she's in his class. Among Riley's classmates are best friend Maya, crush Lucas, and quirky Farkle, son of Cory and Topanga's peer Stuart Minkus.

The kids aren't used to being in the great outdoors, so cheerful head counselor Lou and camp heartthrob Xander help the siblings adjust to being at camp and show them the ropes of outdoor life. While Emma and Ravi become counselors in training, learning how to be responsible role models for younger campers, Zuri becomes friends with a couple of the kids at the camp, studious Tiffany and compulsive liar Jorge. Together, the Ross children settle into their new lives as they adapt to their summer home away from home.

programme.title: Pawn Stars
programme.desc: This series opens the doors to the only family-run pawnshop in Las Vegas, where three generations of the Harrison family use their sharp-eyed skills to assess what's real and what's fake. Objects the colorful customers bring in range from the obscure to the truly historic, and it's up to the guys at the Gold & Silver Pawn Shop -- with help at times from their network of experts -- to reveal the sometimes surprising answer to "What's this worth?"

programme.title: Bay of Blood
programme.desc: The filmmaker highlights the massacre that took place in East Pakistan when the Pakistani army slaughtered scores of people.

programme.title: Counting Cars
programme.desc: When Rick Harrison and the rest of the "Pawn Stars" gang need to restore a vehicle they're buying, they sometimes turn to Danny "The Count" Koker, who runs Las Vegas auto shop Count's Kustoms. The Count now gets his own half-hour show that showcases his ability to restore and customize classic rides. When he sees a vehicle he wants, whether it's at an auto auction or at a roadside diner, Koker does all he can to acquire it. When successful, he and his team then work to restore and modify the cars and motorcycles to quickly flip them for a profit. From classic cars like Thunderbirds and Corvettes to sidecar motorcycles and everything in between, if it has wheels, the Count's Kustoms team can make it look spectacular.

programme.title: The Einstein Challenge

programme.title: American Pickers
programme.desc: Mike Wolfe and Frank Fritz are Midwestern pickers that travel across America in search of rare artefacts and national treasures that they can buy from the collectors they visit and then sell in their antiques shops or, in some cases, put in their personal collections; they usually have to dig through boxes or piles filled with items that have accumulated over the years, which are often located in such places as barns or spare rooms in the owners' homes; while the guys are willing to buy pretty much anything old, their particular interests include items having to do with the auto industry and classic toys.

programme.title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
programme.desc: Host Dan Aykroyd uncovers some of the most mysterious and bizarre inventions, creatures, people and things throughout history, by using dynamic visuals, archival images, and expert interviews.

programme.title: How Disney Built America
programme.desc: "How Disney Built America" explores the history of Walt Disney and how the iconic Disney brand, fueled by the creation of beloved characters, cherished family films, thrilling theme parks, technological innovations, and more, continues to shape generations as a cultural and worldwide phenomenon. This nostalgia-filled ride paints a vivid picture of the world of Walt Disney and the empire he built, with each episode focusing on a different example of the game-changing brilliance in Disney's history, including inventing the world's most recognizable characters, creating the animated features industry, revolutionizing the concept of merchandising, and using groundbreaking engineering to construct Disneyland, Walt Disney World, and beyond. Rarely seen archival material, original dramatic recreations, and key interviews expand on how the brand is forever woven into the fabric of American life.

programme.title: Tour D' Royale
programme.desc: The filmmaker takes a deep dive into the rich culture and heritage of Rajasthan and Gujarat by visiting luxurious palaces and mansions.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: Investigators circle the globe in search of evidence in their quest to determine whether life on Earth began in outer space and if aliens influenced mankind in ancient times. Did extraterrestrial beings visit Earth and share information about technology and influence human religions? And more importantly, if aliens visited the planet before, will they return? Alien theorists believe that the answer to both questions is a resounding yes.

programme.desc: Big fan of pancakes? Live for Chinese takeout? Craving a cheeseburger and fries? Now you can trace the origins of some of your favorite foods. Host Bobby Bognar takes viewers on a journey from farm to plate to show them how some of their favorite foods come to be.

programme.title: American Pickers
programme.desc: Mike Wolfe and Frank Fritz are Midwestern pickers that travel across America in search of rare artefacts and national treasures that they can buy from the collectors they visit and then sell in their antiques shops or, in some cases, put in their personal collections; they usually have to dig through boxes or piles filled with items that have accumulated over the years, which are often located in such places as barns or spare rooms in the owners' homes; while the guys are willing to buy pretty much anything old, their particular interests include items having to do with the auto industry and classic toys.

programme.title: American Restoration
programme.desc: A group of experts tries to restore American vintage items to their original state while facing a number of challenges during the job.

programme.title: Part I
programme.desc: Professional buyers go to auctions and explore storage units in search of lucrative as well as interesting items that could fetch them a big profit.

programme.title: Pawn Stars
programme.desc: This series opens the doors to the only family-run pawnshop in Las Vegas, where three generations of the Harrison family use their sharp-eyed skills to assess what's real and what's fake. Objects the colorful customers bring in range from the obscure to the truly historic, and it's up to the guys at the Gold & Silver Pawn Shop -- with help at times from their network of experts -- to reveal the sometimes surprising answer to "What's this worth?"

programme.title: Counting Cars
programme.desc: When Rick Harrison and the rest of the "Pawn Stars" gang need to restore a vehicle they're buying, they sometimes turn to Danny "The Count" Koker, who runs Las Vegas auto shop Count's Kustoms. The Count now gets his own half-hour show that showcases his ability to restore and customize classic rides. When he sees a vehicle he wants, whether it's at an auto auction or at a roadside diner, Koker does all he can to acquire it. When successful, he and his team then work to restore and modify the cars and motorcycles to quickly flip them for a profit. From classic cars like Thunderbirds and Corvettes to sidecar motorcycles and everything in between, if it has wheels, the Count's Kustoms team can make it look spectacular.

programme.title: How Disney Built America
programme.desc: "How Disney Built America" explores the history of Walt Disney and how the iconic Disney brand, fueled by the creation of beloved characters, cherished family films, thrilling theme parks, technological innovations, and more, continues to shape generations as a cultural and worldwide phenomenon. This nostalgia-filled ride paints a vivid picture of the world of Walt Disney and the empire he built, with each episode focusing on a different example of the game-changing brilliance in Disney's history, including inventing the world's most recognizable characters, creating the animated features industry, revolutionizing the concept of merchandising, and using groundbreaking engineering to construct Disneyland, Walt Disney World, and beyond. Rarely seen archival material, original dramatic recreations, and key interviews expand on how the brand is forever woven into the fabric of American life.

programme.title: Border
programme.desc: In 1971, along the border region of Longewala, a small battalion of Indian soldiers go up against a 2000 well armed Pakistani strike force.

programme.title: Kumari Jille Ke Thugs
programme.desc: Caught in the turmoil of prison life, a determined man forges alliances with fellow inmates, plotting a daring plan to escape and regain their freedom.

programme.title: Darr ka Ghar
programme.desc: A man decides to sell his parent's house after their demise. However, he fails to find a suitable buyer as the house is haunted.

programme.title: Udhayam NH4
programme.desc: Prabhu, a young college student, kidnaps his lover Rithika when her father disapproves of their relationship. Manoj Menon, an encounter specialist, is appointed to track them down.

programme.title: Lakshmi Mahima
programme.desc: Goddess Lakshmi, revered as the personification of love, is soul-bound to Lord Vishnu and serves as the essential link between him and his devotees.

programme.title: Chithha
programme.desc: Living a quiet life with his niece, Eeswaran manages to provide for her and nurtures her like a parent. However, his journey takes an insidious turn when she goes missing.

programme.title: Hulchul
programme.desc: A man and a woman come from two feuding families and pretend to be in love for revenge. Their plan goes awry when they fall in love, and they must work on bringing together their families.

programme.title: Sangili Bungili Darwaza Khol
programme.desc: Vasu purchases a bungalow for his family, but after moving in, they feel the presence of supernatural forces.

programme.title: Tiger Nageswara Rao
programme.desc: During the 1970s, thief Tiger Nageswara Rao masterminds a series of daring heists and becomes a legend for his ingenious methods of outwitting the police.

programme.title: Maragadha Naanayam
programme.desc: Two small-time thieves who work for a jewel smuggler take up a contract to locate a cursed emerald medallion. With the help of a priest, they summon three spirits to guide them in their quest.

programme.title: The Family Star
programme.desc: Govardhan, a devoted architect from Hyderabad, juggles supporting his extended family while seeking a partner who understands his commitments. When he discovers Aadhya's thesis on his family, he challenges her, leading to unexpected twists.

programme.title: The Ghazi Attack
programme.desc: In 1971, an Indian naval submarine, S21, intercepts a Pakistani submarine, PNS Ghazi, in Indian waters during a routine surveillance and thwarts its mission of destroying INS Vikrant.
